infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Moto Dash connects to your bike's Bluetooth OBD adapter to read RPM, temperatures, oil pressure and fault codes.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Moto Dash uses GPS to show your speed, heading and a live map of your ride.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Moto Dash uses GPS to show your speed, heading and a live map of your ride, including while the screen is docked.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take a photo of your bike so the AI can cut it out and use it as your dash artwork.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pick a photo of your bike so the AI can cut it out and use it as your dash artwork.
